project.title: When the Wife Goes Away, the Husband Is Happy!

beats.title: Teja's Endless Questions & Departure
beats.description: Teja bombards Shiva with her usual loving checklist of questions before heading off to her parents' house for two days. Shiva bids her a polite, saintly farewell.

beats.title: The Bachelor Celebration
beats.description: The moment the door clicks shut, Shiva breaks into an exuberant victory dance, takes over the sofa with jumbo chips, and basks in total freedom.

beats.title: The Cooking Catastrophe
beats.description: Hunger strikes. Shiva attempts to cook dal following an online tutorial, resulting in a cloud of kitchen smoke and an unrecognizable culinary disaster.

beats.title: The Quiet Evening & Loneliness
beats.description: Eating takeout alone in front of the TV, Shiva looks at Teja's empty armchair, suddenly missing her constant chatter and presence.

beats.title: The Morning Phone Call
beats.description: Teja calls to check in. Shiva pretends to be a self-sufficient master of the house, but background beeps give him away. Teja announces her early return, making Shiva's face light up.

beats.title: The Surprise Return & Kitchen Duty
beats.description: Teja suddenly knocks at the door, catching Shiva mid-monologue. She playfully orders 'Mr. Singer' to clean the kitchen, and they share a loving laugh.
